hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(yml|yaml|properties)'; then echo '⚠️ WARNING: Editing config file. Ensure no real credentials (passwords, API keys) are being committed. Use placeholders or environment variables.'; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.java'; then echo '🔨 Compiling...'; mvn compile -q 2>&1 | grep -E 'ERROR|BUILD' | tail -10; fi
